items.summary: hiprtc on Windows (TheRock 7.14) returns HIPRTC_ERROR_COMPILATION with an empty log when hiprtcCreateProgram's name is an absolute path (C:\...\k.cu or C:/.../k.cu); a relative name compiles the same source. CuPy works around it (base name).
hipcc.exe on Windows rebuilds the clang command line without quoting: -DX=extern "C" becomes -DX=extern + file C, and -I paths with spaces are split. CuPy works around it.

hiprtc on Windows with the MSVC STL include dirs: <complex> fails with 'call to signbit is ambiguous' (MSVC complex:575 vs hiprtc_runtime.h device signbit overloads). Breaks CuPy kernels that include C++ std headers (cupy/xsf, mdspan GUFunc-like kernels). Not worked around in the port.

decided.note: bounded workaround attempt in the port (~2h); ROCm bug report either way

items.summary: On Windows __clang_hip_math.h nan(const char*) computes (uint64_t)mantissa | (0xFFF << 51) with an int-typed 0xFFF, so the shift is undefined/zero and double nan("") returns 0.0 instead of NaN (nanf works). Fix: 0xFFFULL << 51 in the !_WIN32 else branch. Hits CuPy jit nan, special zeta/zetac, signal sawtooth/square on Windows ROCm.

decided.note: report to ROCm only; no workaround in the port; list the 7 failures as a known ROCm issue in the PR

items.summary: Migrate CuPy's HIP build-time and runtime compiles from hipcc to amdclang++ (and ROCm discovery from hipconfig to rocm-sdk path --root), per TheRock's hipcc deprecation (docs/development/hipcc_migration.md; TheRock#9849). jeff 2026-11-09: a separate task from the Windows port.

decided.note: separate task from the Windows port
